visual.name: bfusionPortfolio360
visual.description: 360-degree portfolio dashboard: hero KPI strip (Budget / On-Time / Top Department / Top Project) over a 4x2 analysis grid of bullet bars and ranked dual-bar lists, with smart-insight rail and what-if Top-N control.

dataRoles.name: reportingDate
dataRoles.description: Bind to a MONTH-GRAIN Calendar column (e.g. Calendar[Period] or Calendar[MonthCounter]) — NOT Calendar[Date]. Daily grain on a portfolio of >50 projects blows past Power BI's 30k-row table dataView cap and triggers a 'Too many values' truncation warning. The visual buckets by month internally either way.

dataRoles.name: segment
dataRoles.description: Categorical dimension for Top-N rankings and per-segment bullets (e.g. Plan_Projects[BusinessUnit_Value]).

dataRoles.name: projectName
dataRoles.description: Project identifier for the Top Project hero tile and Top-N project ranking (e.g. Plan_Projects[Name]).

dataRoles.name: scheduleHealth
dataRoles.description: Schedule health bucket (e.g. Plan_Projects[ScheduleHealth_Value]) used for At-Risk / Slipping / On-Track counts.

dataRoles.name: lifecycle
dataRoles.description: Lifecycle / phase column for the Schedule section funnel (e.g. Plan_Projects[Phase_Value] or [Status]).

dataRoles.name: budget
dataRoles.description: Budget amount per row. Recommend [Status Reports - Total Budget] or [Total Budget] for period-aware values.

dataRoles.name: forecast
dataRoles.description: Forecast amount per row. Recommend [Forecast Cost] or [Status Reports - Total Forecast].

dataRoles.name: actual
dataRoles.description: Actual or Estimate-at-Completion amount per row (e.g. [Actual Cost] or [Status Reports - Total Actuals]).

dataRoles.name: onTimeFlag
dataRoles.description: Row-level 1 when the project is on track, 0 otherwise. Use [Portfolio360 | On-Time Flag] or equivalent.

dataRoles.name: budgetTarget
dataRoles.description: Target budget for the bullet bars (single value per row). Defaults to [Portfolio360 | Budget Target].

dataRoles.name: onTimeTarget
dataRoles.description: Target on-time delivery percentage (0-1 or 0-100). Defaults to [Portfolio360 | On-Time Target %].

dataRoles.name: utilization
dataRoles.description: Portfolio utilization percentage (0-1 or 0-100). Recommend [Resource Utilization%].

dataRoles.name: capacity
dataRoles.description: Resource capacity in hours / FTE. Recommend [Resource Capacity] or [Netto Capacity].

dataRoles.name: demand
dataRoles.description: Scheduled / committed demand in hours / FTE. Recommend [ResPlan - Total Hours Scheduled].

dataRoles.name: overAllocatedCount
dataRoles.description: Count of resources above 100% allocation, e.g. [Capacity | Over-Allocated Resource Count]. Detected by the model, not inferred from segment totals.

dataRoles.name: activeRisks
dataRoles.description: Count of active risks. Recommend [Portfolio - Total ActiveRisks].

dataRoles.name: activeIssues
dataRoles.description: Count of active issues. Recommend [Portfolio - Total ActiveIssues].

dataRoles.name: roi
dataRoles.description: Portfolio ROI percentage (0-1 or 0-100). Recommend [Portfolio - ROI%].

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model.

mode.description: Surface theme for the visual chrome. Auto follows the report theme's background.

background.description: Custom mode only. Plot and root background.

surface.description: Custom mode only. Header, toolbar, panels, tiles and tooltips.

textColor.description: Custom mode only. Primary text colour.

mutedColor.description: Custom mode only. Labels, captions and axis text.

ruleColor.description: Custom mode only. Separators, tile borders and axis lines.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here (manual fallback when the License Token data role is not bound). Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.

title.description: Title text shown in the dark header band. Leave empty to suppress.

defaultExpanded.description: Auto-collapses to a 28px right-edge strip on narrow viewports regardless.

topN.description: How many items to show in the Top-N ranked panels (3-10).

atRiskThresholdPct.description: Forecast-vs-budget variance % above which a project is flagged At Risk (0-30).
